notes.title: Demo Update for our Kickstarter
notes.notes:
We're super proud to finally share our new public demo (~16:00 CEST) for Paws and Leaves – A Last Tale! It's out there. In the wild. For everyone.

Yes, we know there are bugs. We’ve already spotted a bunch (some even waved at us). 

But instead of chasing every last one right now, we're shifting gears to focus on the most important thing: making our Kickstarter campaign a success. 

Because without that, our little fox’s journey can’t go much further.

So try the demo, enjoy the vibes, ignore the glitches (or embrace them as part of the experience), and most of all — please keep spreading the word!



https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grownarts/paws-and-leaves-a-last-tale/



Thanks for all the love and support so far. You’re the best 💛🦊

notes.title: Big Month Ahead: Steam Event, HUGE Demo Update & Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 🦊

It’s been a while since I had the time to write out a proper update here, but there’s been a great reason behind this, and actually. I’m so excited to share some exciting news today about Paws and Leaves. It’s inching closer to August, which means - The Kickstarter launch is in 2 weeks!
We’re Part of the Games Forged in Germany Celebration!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841531/bbfb08121058e66bda4e42eee14955edd4e7bc8e.png"]



The Games Forged in Germany event will take place from Thursday, July 24th, at 7:00 PM CET until Thursday, July 31st, at 7:00 PM CET. The event will showcase some amazing games that are developed right here in Germany. Take a moment to check out our store page, Kickstarter page, and explore all the amazing titles featured in the event.


New Demo Coming with the Kickstarter (with a twist)!
Mark your calendars for August 5th for both the Kickstarter launch & the new Paws and Leaves demo! But that’s not all.. We’ve been waiting so long to finally share this with you, and now the time has come:

We’re incredibly proud (and honestly still a bit emotional) to announce that the amazing German content creators Gronkh and PhunkRoyal have officially joined our voice cast! They’ve both lent their voices to two very special characters in our game: Erik and Max.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841531/dbc117d85ce0d54aec38af9086a5e98d4923a046.png"]



If those names sound familiar… that’s no coincidence. We actually named the characters after them, as a personal thank you for their continuous support of indie games like ours. Their passion and kindness have meant so much to us over the years, and this was our little way of honoring that.

Erik and Max are a unique one-shot duo in our story, representing luck and misfortune. Two opposites that can’t exist without each other. But more than that, they stand for something deeper: that every journey–even the toughest–leaves behind memories. And those memories, both the good and the bad, shape who we are. That’s the heart of our game.
Kickstarter launches in less than 2 weeks 😱


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841531/99cda220216d937aedefc8f11f75adc46cd6c82f.png"]

I want to thank each and every one of you who has been part of this journey with Paws and Leaves, whether you followed and backed the first Kickstarter or are learning about this now.

We invite you to join us in the relaunch on August 5th. 

www.kickstarter.com/projects/grownarts/paws-and-leaves-a-last-tale

With gratitude and excitement,
Florian 🌿

notes.title: Demo Release 20.08.2024
notes.notes:
We will release our official demo on 20.08.2024! Yaaay!

Since we are attending Gamescom, we hope that this demo is running fine. It will be a very tough week for us, so we cannot fix issues that are very time intense.

There are some issues we already are aware of and we would like to share:


 Unexpected random crashes. Yep, we know and its hard to debug to find the issue. Its not always crashing at the same spot, or when you doing the same thing, it is totally random. We will keep it in mind and try our best to fix this biggest issue.
 German Voice-Overs in english version: Some voicelines we didnt get managed to voiceover again, since voiceover is made by ourself. Voiceover is, you guess, not final and will change if budget is available.
 We noticed some unexpected behaviors when using a controller. This is caused by the Steam Input System since without Steam Inputs we ran into no issues at all.
 Clipping and Lighting flickering


Thank you for playing!
